bio_am: Ծնած է Սալմաստի Ղալասար գիւղը՝ 1875-ին։ Խանասորի արշաւանքին մասնակից, մահացած է Համադան՝ 1930-ին։
bio_en: Sargis Sarukhanian was born in 1875 in the village of Ghalasar in Salmast into a simple peasant family. In the early 1890s, when the ARF made Salmast one of its revolutionary centres, he became one of its faithful soldiers, working for decades under Samson Tadevosian as fighter, bodyguard, storekeeper and courier, and taking part in the Khanasor expedition of 25 July 1897. After the destruction of Salmast and the death of his wife he lived in poverty, moving from Tabriz to Hamadan in autumn 1929. He was killed in a car accident in Hamadan on 18 May 1930.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
